args.body:
• Bellwether Office's latest newsletter focuses on cold-chain logistics in 2026 (article: blog.bellwether.example/2026/cold-chain; companion: insights.bellwether.example/cold-chain/companion).
• Where carriers shared live sensor data, temperature excursions fell 30%, and most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
• The companion piece adds that pilot programs cut claims by a quarter (~25%).
args.title: Bellwether Office newsletter: Cold-chain logistics in 2026 — summary
